note: NECO Agricultural Science round 5 (R28 top-up): texture vs structure, hygroscopic and gravitational water, liming, nitrogen yellowing, potassium and resistance; sweet potato vines, ginger rhizomes, biennial carrot, legume fixation, intercropping, zero tillage, mulching, strip cropping; ladybirds as biological control, herbicide, fumigation, fungal smut and rust, vaccination immunity, quarantine; dipping, castration, deep litter, beeswax, health signs; genotype, hybrid vigour, inbreeding depression; inventory record, tannery linkage, feed mill; deforestation and bush burning harms, variable costs. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Agric (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
